title: Q-Regularized Generative Auto-Bidding: From Suboptimal Trajectories to Optimal Policies
abstract: arXiv:2601.02754v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce, auto-bidding has become a key asset in optimizing advertising performance under diverse advertiser environments. The current approaches focus on reinforcement learning (RL) and generative models. These efforts imitate offline historical behaviors by utilizing a complex structure with expensive hyperparameter tuning. The suboptimal trajectories further exacerbate the difficulty of policy learning.   To address these challenges, we proposes QGA, a novel Q-value regularized Generative Auto-bidding method. In QGA, we propose to plug a Q-value regularization with double Q-learning strategy into the Decision Transformer backbone. This design enables joint optimization of policy imitation and action-value maximization, allowing the learned bidding policy to both leverage experience from the dataset and alleviate the adverse impact of the suboptimal trajectories. translated_title: Q值正则化的生成式自动出价：从次优轨迹到最优策略
translated_abstract: 随着电子商务的快速发展，自动出价已成为在各种广告主环境中优化广告性能的关键资产。当前方法侧重于强化学习（RL）和生成模型。这些努力通过利用复杂的结构进行昂贵的超参数调整来模仿离线历史行为。次优轨迹进一步加剧了策略学习的难度。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了QGA，一种新颖的Q值正则化生成式自动出价方法。在QGA中，我们提出将带有双重Q学习策略的Q值正则化插入到决策Transformer主干中。这种设计实现了策略模仿和动作价值最大化的联合优化，使学习到的出价策略既能利用数据集的经验，又能减轻次优轨迹的不利影响。此外，为了安全探索...
tldr: 本文提出QGA方法，通过将Q值正则化与双重Q学习整合进决策Transformer，实现了从次优历史轨迹中联合优化策略模仿和动作价值最大化，从而提升自动出价性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes QGA, which integrates Q-value regularization with double Q-learning into the Decision Transformer backbone to jointly optimize policy imitation and action-value maximization from suboptimal trajectories, enhancing auto-bidding performance.
